t_psd.why: x87 excess precision in four1/realfft reaching Psd's decibels. Under -fexcess-precision=fast modern GCC keeps 80-bit intermediates the object narrows to 32 bits mid-butterfly, and by the time the transform reaches a decibel the divergence is up to 0.043 dB on bins near -85 dB, where cancellation dominates. It is NOT closable with a tolerance: the smallest separation between two V90PreFilter reference loops that give DIFFERENT answers is SSD 0.00268 dB^2 (AscendNULL vs AscendNULLCodec2, refLoopsType2), a distance of 0.0518 dB, and 0.043 dB on six points moves a signature by 0.105 dB -- four times the separation, so the excess precision can flip autoSelection's winner. `Psd::getFrequencies` is the same register one site over and is NOT the FFT: the object computes `(long double)i * sampleRate * (1.0L / m_length)` as three extended steps with one rounding at the store -- `fildll m_length`; `fld1`; `fdivrp`; `fildll i`; `fmul %st(2),%st`; `fmul %st(1),%st`; `fstps (%esi,%ecx,4)` at .text+0x469ed..0x46a0e -- while the modern `-ffast-math` profile reassociates it to a single multiply with a reciprocal (`fildll`; `fdivrs <sampleRate>`; `fildl`; `fmul`; `fstps`), 1 ULP on bin 39 (got 1139243841, reference 1139243840). `-fno-associative-math` restores a two-multiply form, but the object's own profile is `-ffast-math`, and the period compiler at those exact flags does NOT reassociate: period passes all 8169 getFrequencies checks. `make period` passes all of t_psd's groups: the period compiler has no divergence here, and it is the tier that decides.

t_v90equproc.why: x87 excess precision on `float err = soft - fdec` inside `V90Equalizer::process`. The object subtracts two values it has already narrowed to `float` in memory and leaves the DIFFERENCE in a register (`fsub %st(1),%st` at 0x394ef); that difference then feeds the squared-error accumulator, the DFE step and the high-error test, and GCC 3.4.2 spills it -- rounding it back to `float` -- only where a call forces the x87 stack out. Where `soft` is past a short's range the RESET slicer returns the x87 indefinite -32768, so the exact difference needs ONE bit more than a `float` carries and the spilled and unspilled readings part company; half an ulp there is hundreds of counts in `word_78`. The `the phase 4 state arms` group reaches the same subtraction from the phase-4 state path and fails 1 of 18023 for the same reason. THE SAME SOURCE IS EXACTLY GREEN ON THE PERIOD COMPILER: 120,974 differential checks, 0 failed, GCC 3.4.2 at the project's own flags, and period passes all 18023 of the phase 4 state arms. On GCC 13 it fails 731, and the failures are `word_78`, `word_7c`, `meanErrorEnergyCurrent` and the connection evaluator's average -- every one of them downstream of that one subtraction. IT IS NOT CLOSABLE BY CHOOSING A TYPE, and all three candidates were measured: `long double err` gives 59 on GCC 13 and is wrong on 3.4.2 as well; forcing the narrowing at every use (`volatile float` round trip) gives 733 on GCC 13 and 1 on 3.4.2; the plain `float` the author wrote gives 731 and 0. The object's own behaviour is not expressible portably -- it rounds at some uses and not others, and which is which is the register allocator's -- so the source is the object's, `make period` proves it, and the modern build declares. `-fexcess-precision=standard` would close it and is a translation-unit-wide change to flags this tree derived from the object; finding F1453's t_psd entry is the same class with the same disposition.
